mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < 0% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 0% and UNRATE MoM < 0% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM < 0% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < 0% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over a 3-year rolling window.
